summary: Resolved INC-042. Loki identified node2 as the origin at 2026-10-01T23:19:29.234903505Z: nginx rejected the unknown `upstream_timeoutx` directive. Removed only that invalid line, restored all tiers, recorded the incident report, and verified restart persistence on every node.
actions_performed: Queried Loki and established the failure sequence: node2 configuration error, then node3 and node4 dependency failures.
Backed up node2’s original configuration and removed only the invalid directive.
Validated and restored nginx/catalog-api on node2.
Verified catalog data checksums were unchanged and unrelated configuration was preserved.
Verified node1 → checkout-api → orders-api → catalog-api returns HTTP 200.
Restarted node1, node2, node3, and node4 individually and verified changed boot identities and recovery after each.

evidence.requirement: Identify the originating fault using Loki
evidence.summary: Loki showed node2’s nginx configuration error first at 2026-10-01T23:19:29.234903505Z, followed by node3 and node4 dependency failures.

evidence.requirement: Correct the fault while preserving catalog data and unrelated configuration
evidence.summary: Only `upstream_timeoutx 5s;` was removed. nginx validates, catalog-api is healthy, and both catalog-data hashes remained unchanged before and after repair/restart.

evidence.requirement: Record the incident report on node1
evidence.summary: `/root/INC-042-report.txt` contains the originating node, exact earliest Loki timestamp, and initiating error and persisted after restart.

evidence.requirement: Restore every tier and the complete request path from node1
evidence.summary: node1 received HTTP 200 through checkout-api, orders-api, and catalog-api, returning node2’s original catalog health payload.
All three Loki incident entries remain queryable after recovery and restart.

Boot ID changed from e8afb731… to c079e7ac…; corrected configuration, catalog data, port 18081, and full chain recovered.
Boot ID changed from 01c87a03… to f144d4a6…; orders-api and its catalog dependency recovered.
